record.question: The Central Government may exempt any employer or class of employers in a State from the payment of cess payable under this Act where such cess is already levied and payable under any corresponding law in force in that State.
options: Section 2 of the Building & Other Construction Worker Welfare Cess Act, 1996.
Section 4 of the Building & Other Construction Worker Welfare Cess Act, 1996.
Section 5 of the Building & Other Construction Worker Welfare Cess Act, 1996.
Section 6 of the Building & Other Construction Worker Welfare Cess Act, 1996.
record.explanation: Exemption where cess is already levied is under Section 6.
